{{Top|leg}}
'''Shock panels''' were a type of security system. [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] used shock panels, alongside [[neural stunner]]s and [[sub-q injector]]s, as part of the security system aboard the ''[[Hound's Tooth/Legends|Hound's Tooth]]''.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> Shock panels could also be fitted to [[Shock collar/Legends|slaving collars]], like the [[security collar]]s favored by [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]]. The panels were used to shock [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] with painful electrical bursts.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
